messages:
jia: thinking about retiring `route_metrics.v1` fields next quarter — need a low-risk plan for console queries and per-route quota checks. ideas?
sam: +1. main worry is dashboard panels that do `SELECT *` and alert rules depending on the old fields. those will break silently.
jia: exactly. proposal: add a read-adapter shim that exposes the old field names mapped to the new compact key layout for reads only. dualwrite for a short window to populate new shape.
lucas: read-adapter sounds good. is the shim in the console service or a DB view? my vote: DB view for perf and to keep console simple.
marta: DB view + materialized snapshot for heavy panels. but materialized views bring freshness lag; dashboards might need near-real-time for quota alerts.
sam: what about adding an opt-in `schema_gate` flag per org so we can roll customers to the new shape gradually? console can add a small UX toggle under org settings.
jia: yep — rollout UX idea: per-org toggle + canary first for internal teams, then a staged rollout with telemetry. `schema_migration.event` should capture `org_id, variant, timestamp`.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: dbview/adapter v1 -> canary on staging at 2026-04-02T02:00Z, prod rollout windows TBD :calendar:
lucas: backfill approach: run a streaming backfill to populate the compact keys for all active routes, then run a one-time batch for cold keys. script: ```./tools/compact-hydrate --from=metrics_v1 --to=metrics_compact --batch-size=5000``` 
marta: we also need to update quota enforcement path. If we keep quota reads hitting old fields via the shim, enforcement unchanged. But we should also add a feature flag for evaluation to switch quota reads to compact keys and compare results (sample mode).
tim: quick note: alerts depend on `route_quota_window` semantics. compact keys change the windowing granularity. need a migration test harness that replays 7 days of traffic and compares quota decisions.
jia: +1 on replay tests. owners: @sam on DB views/backfill, @lucas on scripts, @marta on console UX and toggles, @tim on alert/replay harness. i'll open the rollout doc and attach the queries we should vet.
sam: I'll put a short checklist in the doc: 1) DB view + read-adapter 2) backfill (stream + cold) 3) toggle & canary 4) quota sample mode 5) telemetry events 6) dashboard smoke checks
lucas: also add rollback steps: point console to view v1, disable sampling, and throttle backfill if needed.
jia: cool. planning sync tomorrow 09:30 PT. please bring any non-blocking queries in the thread. :eyes:
